title: The Planet Found Through Mathematics
short_teaser: Before Neptune was seen through a telescope, astronomers noticed that Uranus did not move exactly as expected.
story: Before Neptune was seen through a telescope, astronomers noticed that Uranus did not move exactly as expected. Calculations suggested that another unseen planet might be pulling on it. Sometimes the effects of something reveal its presence before the thing itself can be seen. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist explaining it away too quickly. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Sometimes the effects of something reveal its presence before the thing itself can be seen. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist explaining it away too quickly.
spark_application: Write down one unexpected result or unanswered question from your own work. List three possible explanations before choosing one. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
